usedFor: MyDocSafe holds signed documents, and Sangam CRM records the signer through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Document is Signed” in MyDocSafe, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Once every required party has signed, the lead in Sangam CRM is created or updated.

watchOut: “Create or Update Lead” finds the lead by ID, email or phone, so map one of those.
